description: Led migration from SolidWorks to AutoCAD Electrical, standardizing symbols, PLC modules, title blocks and wire‑numbering macros; protected $3M–$8M in annual automation revenue. Built a VBA‑based HMI platform that replaced licensed third‑party visualization, saving $15K–$40K per deployment. Created an Excel‑driven PLC tag auto‑generation system for badge access, reducing commissioning labour and protecting $20K–$50K across deployments. Designed hardened Raspberry Pi remote access with certificate‑based authentication and engineered PLC/HMI/robotic automation software for deterministic motion control and throughput stability.
highlights: Migrated to AutoCAD Electrical & standardized libraries ($3M–$8M revenue protected)
Built custom HMI platform (saved $15K–$40K per deployment)
Automated PLC tag generation & reduced commissioning labour ($20K–$50K saved)
